title: Machine-readable Work Item status interface
rawUserRequest: Implement WI-06 of the approved 14-WI AI Cockpit improvement plan: publish a machine-readable per-Work-Item status interface and optional index for external Agents, preserve current_status.md, and fail closed for stale, malformed, or cross-Work-Item evidence. Execute in English low-token mode with a dedicated branch, PR, archive, merge, and closure lifecycle.

declaredIntent.summary: Expose each active Work Item's evidence-derived state and safe next actions as JSON for external Agent orchestration.

outOfScope: Changing governance decisions, gate policy, or current_status.md rendering
Replacing Work Item Intelligence runtime facts or creating a scheduler/orchestrator
Network, provider, CI, billing, or token integrations
Inferring progress percentages from Agent self-report

sources.reason: Existing evidence-derived human-facing status model to preserve and project.
Canonical recommendation, signal, and human decision derivation.
Existing repository-local machine status boundary and fail-closed vocabulary.
Existing distinction between repository-local read-only status and external orchestration.

riskAssessment.reason: The projection must never turn stale, malformed, or cross-Work-Item evidence into a green state.

reasons: The status schema is a governance-facing machine interface and requires strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The interface is bounded to local Contract/Summary evidence and must fail closed on invalid bindings.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The generator publishes one schema-validated JSON status per active Work Item under .ai/cockpit/work-items and an index containing independently derived entries.

Each status exposes Work Item ID, green/yellow/red/unknown state, lifecycle phase, blocking and blocker reasons, human decision requirement, safe actions, base commit, branch, last verification time, evidence freshness, and generation time.
Malformed Contract/Summary input, stale verification evidence, and cross-Work-Item evidence produce unknown or non-green status with explicit diagnostics and never green.
Two independent active Work Items can be projected without one status being inferred from the other; no scheduler or priority decision is introduced.
Existing .ai/cockpit/current_status.md generation and checks remain unchanged, and the status script CLI, schema, focused tests, and reference documentation are present.
guidelines: Derive status only from attributable local Contract and Summary evidence.
Fail closed for malformed, stale, or cross-Work-Item evidence; never infer green.
Keep the interface read-only and document the JSON schema and safe-action vocabulary.

intent.problem: External Agents need a stable JSON status per Work Item; parsing current_status.md is fragile and cannot safely distinguish stale or cross-item evidence.
constraints: Keep one Work Item per branch, Contract, Summary, and archive lifecycle.
Use repository-local evidence only and preserve unknown semantics.
Do not alter policy decisions, scheduling, or current_status.md rendering.
intent.rationale: A small schema-validated projection allows bounded parallel orchestration while preserving evidence-first trust boundaries.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Two active Work Items with independent Contracts and Summaries are projected.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The index contains two independently derived status records with their own branch and base values.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused fixture test creates two active pairs and asserts independent JSON outputs.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Required verification evidence is stale, malformed, or bound to another Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The resulting status is unknown or otherwise non-green and includes an explicit diagnostic.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused tests cover commit mismatch, invalid JSON, and executionContractPath identity mismatch.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The existing current_status.md generator runs after the interface is added.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Markdown status remains generated and checkable through existing targets.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Existing status generation/check tests plus a focused non-interference test.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized implementation of the complete 14-WI plan, including a governance-facing status schema.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
